subject: P2 — Tree-sitter universal decomposer (refactor)
description: Tree-sitter native binding (Hartonomous.Core.Native.TreeSitterNative). TreeSitterDecomposer class. Per-grammar tier-mapping tables (data). Replace hand-rolled parsers (WiktionaryJsonl, UdConllU, TatoebaCsv, Iso639, Omw, WordNet, ModelConfig, ModelCard). Per-language code decomposers (Python, TypeScript, Rust, C, C++, Java, Go, Ruby, Shell). Markup decomposers (HTML, Markdown, LaTeX, AsciiDoc, BibTeX, reStructuredText, org-mode). Config + IDL decomposers (JSON, YAML, TOML, XML, Protobuf, Thrift, GraphQL, SPARQL, OpenAPI). Refactor — happens after corpus + model ingestion validates the pipeline at scale.
